title: alchemilla glaberrima subsp. glabra
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima subsp. glabra, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a perennial herb with rounded leaves and small white flowers, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
